biocontainers.name: plantcv
biocontainers.summary: An image processing package for plant phenotyping.

biotools.summary: PlantCV is a free and open-source package used for image analysis of plant phenotypes. It offers a pipeline for capturing, labeling, and transferring plant images, enabling quantification of traits such as plant size, height, and color.
